name: 3D platformer
core_loop: Read the next platform and time the jump
Chain a double jump over the long gaps
Grab the coins along the route
Touch the checkpoint, then push for the goal ledge

questions.question: How many levels ship in the first build?

acceptance.promise: A single jump clears the authored gap and a double jump clears the long one.
setup: Load the tutorial course with its authored gap_distance
Place the player at the first launch pad
probes: Jump once and record the apex height and landing point
Jump, then jump again at apex, and record the second landing point
evidence: The single-jump apex matches jump_velocity and gravity within tolerance
The single jump lands on the short platform
The double jump lands on the long platform

acceptance.promise: Dying after a checkpoint respawns at that checkpoint with the coins already taken.
setup: Load the course with checkpoint_count checkpoints
Collect two coins and touch the second checkpoint
probes: Kill the player in the next hazard
Read the respawn transform and the coin counter
evidence: The respawn transform equals the second checkpoint marker
The coin counter still reads two
The HUD life or checkpoint readout updates once
